assertions.title: Launch and cancel runs

steps.action: Preflight GET /api/admin/monitor/runs with bearer auth before UI interaction
Set Launch prompt (contains rerun4), set Thinking mode to non-default (always), click Start on default agent card
steps.expected: New run launches and thinking_mode=always applies
steps.observed: Runs launched from Monitor (e.g., run_1773490044359247877, run_1773490190147119807); /v1/runs/{id} shows thinking_mode=always and status running before cancel attempts.

steps.action: Click Stop Active on default agent card while run is running
steps.observed: Stop Active clicked (UI evidence captured), but run finished as completed, not canceled. Fast retry (run_1773490275525290711) also ended completed after click.

steps.action: Click per-row Stop button on specific running row in Recent Main + Subagent Runs table
steps.observed: Per-row Stop clicked on run_1773490190147119807 (and fast retry run_1773490307632314179), but run ended completed, not canceled.

evidence.network: Browser request list captured only POST /v1/runs lines (VAL-MIG-MON-002-browser-network.txt). Supplemental API evidence: preflight-monitor-runs-headers.txt/body.json, VAL-MIG-MON-002-stop-active-run-before.json, VAL-MIG-MON-002-stop-active-run-after.json, VAL-MIG-MON-002-row-stop-run-before.json, VAL-MIG-MON-002-row-stop-run-after.json, VAL-MIG-MON-002-fast-stop-active-result.json, VAL-MIG-MON-002-fast-row-stop-result.json.

assertions.issues: Launch and thinking mode application work, but cancel controls did not produce canceled terminal status for tested runs; runs completed instead (including fast retries where controls were clicked while status was running).

frictions.description: agent-browser network request output did not include response codes/payloads for this flow.
frictions.resolution: Collected supplemental curl/python API artifacts for request outcomes and run statuses.

summary: Validated VAL-MIG-MON-002 on real dashboard surface: run launch + thinking_mode=always observed, but Stop Active and per-row Stop clicks did not yield canceled status on tested runs, so assertion failed.
